import json,pathlib,os
controller_path=pathlib.Path('memory/phase-controller/controller.json')
controller=json.loads(controller_path.read_text())
job_id=controller.get('current_job_id')
job_path=pathlib.Path('memory/phase-controller/jobs')/str(job_id)/'status.json'
job=json.loads(job_path.read_text()) if job_path.is_file() else None
active=[]
root=pathlib.Path('memory/execution-pipeline/governed')/str(job_id)
if root.is_dir():
 for p in sorted(root.iterdir()):
  s=p/'run-state.json'
  if s.is_file():
   try:r=json.loads(s.read_text())
   except Exception:continue
   if r.get('status') in ('queued','launching','running'):
    pid=r.get('worker_pid');alive=None
    if isinstance(pid,int):
     try:os.kill(pid,0);alive=True
     except ProcessLookupError:alive=False
     except PermissionError:alive=True
    active.append({'run_id':p.name,'status':r.get('status'),'stage':r.get('stage'),'worker_pid':pid,'worker_alive':alive,'updated_at':r.get('updated_at')})
print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'controller':controller,'current_job_path':str(job_path),'current_job':job,'active_runs':active},separators=(',',':')))
